# Schema provenance
Official Shopify AI Toolkit / shopify-functions 1.9.1 bundled introspection snapshots, API 2026-04, obtained on 2026-09-16. Source package: Shopify plugin 4.0.1. Files are retained verbatim after gzip decompression. `scripts/materialize-schemas.mjs` converts them into SDL using GraphQL's printSchema; no fields are added. Refresh with authenticated `shopify app function schema` when linking your app, and review schema diffs before upgrading.

The delivery customization snapshot contains an empty `DeprecatedOperation` input, which GraphQL correctly rejects. SDL materialization removes exactly three legacy types (`DeprecatedOperation`, `FunctionResult`, `FunctionRunResult`) and the two legacy mutation fields (`run`, `handleResult`). The supported `cartDeliveryOptionsTransformRun` target and every input field are unchanged. No replacement fields are invented, and query/schema validation remains enabled. The original introspection file remains verbatim.
